evidence: Carries the Mining label, touches `BlockTemplateManager` and `rpc/mining.cpp`, and refactors the `getblocktemplate` caching logic.
rationale: Cleans up node lifetime and global state by moving static template caching into `BlockTemplateManager`. As noted in the description, this prevents 'cached CBlockIndex* can outlive its ChainstateManager (as in unit tests)', enables compile-time thread safety checks, and adds unit testing coverage for template invalidation.
